title: The Hidden Cost Of Free AI Tools
full_monologue: **Free AI tools sound great—but there’s a catch.** They collect your data, sell it, and train bigger models on your expense. You think you’re getting a free service? Think again. Your privacy? Gone. Your creativity? Trapped in someone else’s algorithm. And when you hit a limit? You’re stuck. Pay up or lose access. It’s not just money—it’s your digital soul. What’s your biggest regret about free AI tools?
